questions.question: b753 step zero has stopped at the subject read, (R363)(7)(i). Its control replays (R362), searching the nouns cQ, negative and class group over the findings ledger's level-two headings and the instruments' I- heads. That reaches only 3 of the 6 lines the ruling wants as uncited. It misses FINDINGS :11178 ("class number 2"), FINDINGS :11359 ("class-number-2") and INSTRUMENTS :758 ("SHAPE RULE'S PREDICTION OF n0 AND b(n0)"). Matching the stem "class" reaches 5 of 6 (56 hits). Only adding a fourth noun "b(n", which the ruling does not name, reaches all 6 (57 hits). The citation check waits on this. How should the subject read proceed?

options.label: Hold for a corrected control (Recommended)
options.description: Step zero stays stopped before the subject read. The navigator restates the control's nouns and its matching rule, and the seat reruns them as restated. Nothing is banked until then.

options.label: Add "b(n" as the fourth noun
options.description: Your word adds "b(n" to the control and to b753's own search. The control then reaches 6 of 6, and the subject read and the citation check go ahead.

options.label: Run as ruled, control NOT AS WANTED
options.description: The three nouns run literally. The control is banked NOT AS WANTED (3 of 6) and lettered as a defect. The subject read prints and the citation check goes ahead.
